# Three.js Webspace local runtime

Version **r168 / 0.168.0**. Original unmodified source from [mrdoob/three.js](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r168), copyright Three.js authors, MIT license in this folder.

Exactly the browser modules needed by the Kilns are included: the Three.js ES module, GLTFLoader, OrbitControls and BufferGeometryUtils. Their source files and Git blob checksums match upstream r168. They are served same-origin rather than relying on an external npm CDN for game boot. Poly Haven historical CC0 glTF models remain separate from this MIT JavaScript engine; their licensed source and version record is in the Kilns artifact bank.
